description: Create a PRIVATE custom benchmark (a saved, calculated peer cohort) over Agentery's data — no account needed. Two modes: (A) explicit members: pass `members` (a list of exact handles; product names/domains resolve where unambiguous). (B) fork a market: pass `base_niche` (its slug) plus optional `remove`/`add`. Returns a one-time secret `benchmark_id` (cb_… token) — store it; it's your only key. Use it later in get/update/delete and in market_report/get_price_index/get_price_index_history. Ambiguous names are returned as candidates, never silently resolved; unresolved inputs block creation unless allow_partial:true. All prices/history are computed from Agentery's immutable observations; canonical market data is never changed.

allow_partial.description: Create with only the resolved members when some inputs don't resolve (default false)

base_niche.description: Mode B: slug of the canonical market to fork

members.description: Mode A: exact handles (preferred), product names or domains

remove.description: Mode B: members to drop from the forked market

name: create_custom_benchmark
